notes: uint32_t generator state: seed * 3877 + 29573 stays below 2^30, so no overflow; (double)seed / im is a plain IEEE division.
Linear scan over a fixed-size cumulative double array; ALU lines are written with at most two fwrite calls when they wrap.
Random lines are built in a char[61] and written with fwrite to stdout, fully buffered by setvbuf with a 64 KiB buffer.
gcc -std=c23 -O2, statically linked and stripped, running on a scratch image.
